author: /root/continuity_investigator
contract: Actual configure_host project persistence must emit valid TOML and preserve the installing interpreter path and explicit Codex host arguments, including non-BMP Unicode path characters. An acknowledged created registration may not persist malformed TOML.

baseline.cause: tomllib.TOMLDecodeError: Escaped character is not a Unicode scalar value

limits: Executed on Windows with real temporary configuration files and the real configure_host serializer.
sys.executable is substituted in memory to model installing paths; no host process or model is launched.
The TOML parser failure is platform-neutral; native macOS launcher execution is not claimed.
policy: Frozen test bytes must not be edited by the implementation owner. Runtime repair and supporting mutation verification are separate.
